role.altitude: The soil and plant scientist keeps designing trials, working plots, describing soil profiles, building devices and judging what standards should require; screening literature by hand, retyping field sheets, copying lab reports and running the same statistics each round shrink.
skills_to_grow: Using field apps with standard codes
role.ambitious_version: A scientist whose field data and literature arrive ready for judgement.

tasks.short: Review literature and earlier trials, design field trials, run them, record observations, analyse the data, and decide which methods for controlling weeds, crop diseases or insect pests to advance.

steps.what: Scientist reviews literature and earlier trial results on weeds, crop diseases or insect pests

loop.input: Search results from literature databases on the pest and control method.
loop.output: Results reordered by likely relevance, with extracted trial outcomes and page references.
loop.check: The scientist opens every source used; a second person checks a sample of screening decisions.
loop.stop: The scientist screens by hand when known key studies are missing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Studies use varied terms for pests and methods.

steps.what: Scientist designs field trials of the new or improved methods
Scientist runs field trials: plots, applications and observations
Scientist records observations on paper sheets and types them up
Scientist analyses the trial data
Scientist decides which methods or products to advance

tasks.design: An evidence review tool reorders search results and extracts trial outcomes with page references, and the scientist opens every source used. Observations go into a field app with the plot map and scoring scales, instead of paper sheets typed up later. A scripted analysis per trial design produces the statistics. Designing trials, field work and deciding stay with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Literature was screened by hand and field sheets retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: Evidence review tools, field apps and scripted trial analysis.
tasks.still_hard: Observations that need judgement, such as disease severity.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing in the field why a treatment failed in one block.
tasks.altitude: Less sifting and typing; trials stay.

reach.learn: Whether trial results reach advice sooner.

evidence.claim: An evidence review tool does screening and data extraction; it reports up to 80% time savings, self-reported.
Twelve systematic reviews were redone with a model in about two days, with screening sensitivity of 96.7% against 81.7% for dual human review.

assumptions: Boundary: developing control methods; environmentally safe methods (task 19751) and planting and spraying methods (task 9036) are sibling tasks.
s4 saves the second entry of paper field sheets.
Designing, field work and deciding keep their full time.
research_questions: Are trial results available sooner after harvest?

incremental.description: Scientist sets up field app forms per trial.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few trials; high: many trials with many observations.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review the draft standard, gather scientific evidence, judge what the standard should require, write the advice on regulatory standards for land reclamation or soil conservation, approve it, and submit it.

steps.what: Scientist reviews the draft regulatory standards and consultation documents

loop.input: The draft standard and consultation documents.
loop.output: A list of proposed requirements with page references.
loop.check: Each listed requirement must cite a page; the scientist reads the pages behind each one.
loop.stop: Documents the step cannot read are read in full.

steps.what: Scientist gathers scientific evidence on land reclamation or soil conservation

loop.input: Search results on the requirements in question.
loop.output: Relevant studies first, with extracted findings and page references.
loop.check: The scientist opens every source used; every citation must resolve to a DOI.
loop.stop: The scientist searches by hand when known key studies are missing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Evidence is spread over soil, ecology and agronomy literature.

steps.what: Scientist judges what the standard should require
Scientist writes the advice

loop.input: The scientist's advice points and the evidence pack.
loop.output: A draft advice letter with references.
loop.check: Every citation must resolve to a DOI in the evidence pack; any extra stops the draft; the scientist rewrites the reasoning.
loop.stop: The scientist writes by hand after two failed checks.
loop.why_not_simpler: Each consultation needs its own argument.

steps.what: Scientist checks and approves the final advice
Scientist submits the advice to the regulator

approvals.approved_version: The advice text and references as approved by the scientist in s5, for the consultation named in it; any edit needs a new check before submitting.

tasks.design: An extraction step lists the proposed requirements in the draft standard with page references. An evidence review tool screens the literature on each requirement. The scientist judges what the standard should require. A drafting step writes the advice from the scientist's points, using only references from the evidence pack that resolve to a DOI. The scientist rewrites, approves and submits that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drafts were read in full and evidence searched by hand for each consultation.
tasks.enabler_now: Extraction with page references, evidence review tools and drafting limited to a reference pack.
tasks.still_hard: Standards where the evidence is thin or contested.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which requirement farmers can actually meet.
tasks.altitude: Less reading and searching; judgement stays.

evidence.claim: An evidence review tool does screening and data extraction; it reports up to 80% time savings, self-reported.
GPT-3.5 fabricated 55% and GPT-4 18% of generated citations, so every citation must resolve.

assumptions: Boundary: advising on regulatory standards; developing conservation methods for farmers (task 9024) and land conservation programs (task 20199) are sibling tasks.
Judging, approving and submitting keep their full time.
research_questions: Is advice submitted earlier in consultation windows?

incremental.description: Scientist checks a sample of screening decisions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: short drafts with known evidence; high: long drafts with wide evidence.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather maps and land data, describe soil profiles in the field, record descriptions, load lab analyses, and classify soils by geographic location, landscape position and soil properties.

steps.what: Scientist gathers soil maps, elevation and land cover for the geographic location
Scientist describes soil profiles in the field
Scientist records profile descriptions on paper and types them up
Scientist copies lab analyses of soil properties from lab reports
Scientist classifies the soils on the basis of location, landscape position and soil properties

tasks.design: A GIS template loads the national soil map, elevation and land cover for the study area, instead of downloading and aligning each layer. Profile descriptions go into a field app with standard horizon codes, instead of paper forms typed up later. Lab results are imported from the lab's result files instead of copied from PDF reports. Describing profiles and classifying stay with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Layers were assembled by hand and field and lab data retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: Open land data, field apps with standard codes and lab result imports.
tasks.still_hard: Disturbed soils that do not fit the classes.
tasks.human_edge: Reading a profile's history from its colours and layers.
tasks.altitude: Less data handling; field work and classification stay.

reach.learn: Whether result files are used directly.

evidence.claim: An EU service offers free land cover, land use and water data.

assumptions: Boundary: classifying soils; investigating soil problems (task 9026) and soil responses to management (task 9023) are sibling tasks.
s3 and s4 save the second entry of paper forms and lab reports.
Input contract for s4: about 70% of labs deliver structured result files; s4 is priced at that share.
Describing and classifying keep their full time.
research_questions: Are classifications ready sooner after field work?

incremental.description: Scientist maintains the field form and GIS template.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few profiles; high: large surveys.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify the measurement problem, design improved measurement techniques or soil sampling devices, build and test prototypes, compare with reference methods, and describe the method.

steps.what: Scientist identifies the measurement problem and requirements
Scientist designs the improved measurement technique or soil sampling device
Scientist builds prototypes and tests them in the field
Scientist compares new measurements with reference methods
Scientist writes the method description

tasks.design: A comparison script computes agreement statistics and plots between the new technique and the reference method for each test round, instead of the scientist rebuilding them in a spreadsheet. The method template has fixed sections and pulls in the comparison tables. Designing, building and testing stay with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparison statistics were rebuilt by hand each round.
tasks.still_hard: Soils where the reference method itself is unreliable.
tasks.human_edge: Designing a probe that survives stony soil.

reach.learn: Whether new devices are easier to use.

evidence.claim: Analysis is deterministic code: scripted summary statistics checked on known datasets.

assumptions: Boundary: developing measurement techniques and devices; soil conservation methods for farmers (task 9024) is a sibling task.
Identifying, designing and testing keep their full time.
unknowns: Number of test rounds per method.
research_questions: Do methods reach validation in fewer rounds?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few test rounds; high: many rounds and sites.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
